name: Direct Multifield Volume Ray Casting of Fiber Surfaces
aliases: Direct ray casting of fiber surfaces
definition: A rendering method for bivariate volume data that visualizes fiber surfaces (contours defined by a path in 2D range space) without explicit geometry extraction. It samples directly along rays in domain space and performs geometric tests in range space using a signed distance field derived from fiber surface control polygons (FSCPs).
summary: Direct multifield volume ray casting of fiber surfaces is a rendering method for bivariate volume data that visualizes fiber surfaces without explicit geometry extraction, enabling real-time exploration and pixel-exact rendering with lower preprocess time than mesh extraction methods.
